# Locully

> Locully is a Bangkok-based agency specialising in AI search visibility (GEO / AIO) for healthcare clinics — making them the clinic ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews recommend.

## Main Pages

- [Local Marketing Partner for Fairs & Expos](https://www.locully.org/lead-gen-partner): Locully as your on-the-ground local marketing team for international fairs and expos in Thailand.

- [Blog](https://www.locully.org/blog/): Guides on AI search, GEO/AIO, and SEO for clinics.
